# StructuredTemporalModeling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that imposes explicit structural constraints on how temporal sequences are processed, ensuring orderly and interpretable spike-timing patterns across layers. Improves robustness and predictability of temporal feature extraction, essential for reliable in-network neuromorphic processing.
